# [336. 回文对](https://leetcode-cn.com/problems/palindrome-pairs) [English Version](https://github.com/yanglr/leetcode-ac/blob/master/assets/0300-0399/0336.Palindrome%20Pairs/README_EN.md) ## 题目描述

给定一组 互不相同 的单词， 找出所有 不同 的索引对 (i, j)，使得列表中的两个单词， words[i] + words[j] ，可拼接成回文串。

 

示例 1：

输入：words = ["abcd","dcba","lls","s","sssll"]
输出：[[0,1],[1,0],[3,2],[2,4]] 
解释：可拼接成的回文串为 ["dcbaabcd","abcddcba","slls","llssssll"]

示例 2：

输入：words = ["bat","tab","cat"]
输出：[[0,1],[1,0]] 
解释：可拼接成的回文串为 ["battab","tabbat"]

示例 3：

输入：words = ["a",""]
输出：[[0,1],[1,0]]
 

提示：

  • 1 <= words.length <= 5000
  • 0 <= words[i].length <= 300
  • words[i] 由小写英文字母组成
